newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SCOTLAND RECALL VETERANS FOR ESTONIA REPLAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCOTLAND RECALL VETERANS FOR ESTONIA REPLAY.

text.p: Scotland manager Craig Brown has covered all angles by naming a squad of 27 for the his team's World Cup qualifier against Estonia in Monaco.
The February 11 fixture is a replay of the match abandoned after three seconds in Tallinn last October .
Estonia refused to take the field after the kickoff time was brought forward following Scottish complaints about floodlighting.
Scotland had hoped to be awarded the three points but FIFA ruled a replay.
Brown has gone for experience in the shape of Paul McStay, Ian Ferguson and Alan McLaren, who have not represented their country previously this season.
Ferguson last played in 1994 while his Rangers team mate McLaren and McStay of Celtic missed Euro 96 through injury.

The goalkeepers cover the full spectrum with Andy Goram and veteran Jim Leighton joined by Wimbledon's Neil Sullivan who has forced his way into contention with a good showing during his club's superb season.

Squad: Tom Boyd (Celtic), Craig Burley (Chelsea), Colin Calderwood (Tottenham), John Collins (Monaco), Duncan Ferguson (Everton), Ian Ferguson (Rangers), Kevin Gallacher (Blackburn), Scot Gemmill (Nottingham Forest), Andy Goram (Rangers), Colin Hendry (Blackburn), Scott Howie (Motherwell), Darren Jackson (Hibernian), Eoin Jess (Coventry), Jim Leighton (Hibernian), Paul Lambert (Borussia Dortmund), Brian McAllister (Wimbledon), Gary McAllister (Coventry), Ally McCoist (Rangers), John McGinlay (Bolton), Billy McKinlay (Blackburn), Tosh McKinlay (Celtic), Alan McLaren (Rangers), Jackie McNamara (Celtic), Paul McStay (Celtic), John Spencer (Queens Park Rangers), Neil Sullivan (Wimbledon),
